Legend distinguishes C2F, DISA, Flag Suite, Electrical, Common Spaces, Not In Scope. Seat count confirmed: 16 offices, 82 workstations.

conflict_flags.rationale: Scope was refined during the charrette process. SAES stated initial scope estimate; actual programming produced a smaller footprint. DD Form 1391 and the cost estimate use 20,810 SF as the definitive contract quantity. The 21,000 SF in the charrette narrative is a rounded approximation of the same number. Severity is minor because the conflict is chronological (before vs. after charrette) rather than reflecting genuinely contradictory claims at the same point in time.

conflict_flags.rationale: Two 1391 versions were prepared (DBB and DB) per the charrette report. The DB version is the recommended acquisition strategy per NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic. The $28.023M cost estimate figure is the pre-approval cost estimate; the 1391 DB version rounds down to $27.8M. Severity minor — all three figures are consistent within normal rounding/contingency treatment.
